question: Will GPT-6 be released before the end of October 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves yes if gpt-6 is released before 11.59pm et October 31 2026

Resolves Yes if OpenAI releases A model called GPT-6 or greater before Nov 1, 2026.Outcome verified from OpenAI.

Release must be to the public, outside of a closed beta, though limiting it to a high-cost subscription tier is acceptable.
research:
I couldn't open any article pages (every fetch was refused by the proxy), so everything below comes from search-result summaries. I left out all material dated after 2026-08-18.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question is decided by OpenAI's own announcements of a model named "GPT-6" or higher that is publicly available. A high-cost paid tier counts; a closed beta does not. No URL was given.
- As of 2026-08-18 I found no OpenAI announcement of a model called GPT-6. Mid-August explainers said there was no announced release date and that GPT-5.6 was still the flagship. [aireiter](https://aireiter.com/blog/gpt-6-what-we-know-so-far)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. GPT-6 had not been released or officially named as of mid-August 2026.
- The likely next model, codenamed "Astra" in reports, exists in pre-release form. It may not end up being called GPT-6: one report said OpenAI was deciding between "GPT-6" and folding it into the 5-series as "5.7". [lifearchitect](https://lifearchitect.ai/gpt-6/), [Cryptopolitan](https://www.cryptopolitan.com/openai-unreleased-gpt-6-rattles-ai-market/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-13: Polymarket posted "50% chance GPT-6 is released by the end of next month," meaning by 30 September. [Polymarket on X](https://x.com/Polymarket/status/2087958280836395255)
- August 2026 (exact date unclear): reports of an "August showdown" between GPT-6 and Anthropic's Fable 5.1. [BigGo Finance](https://finance.biggo.com/news/2ed06797-c07e-4ded-b81c-44da86625595), [36Kr](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3913573579494792)
- 2026-08-01: Polymarket posted a 62% chance of release by the end of September. [Polymarket on X](https://x.com/Polymarket/status/2083599487268770219)
- About 2026-07-27: Axios-sourced reports said Altman would demo OpenAI's next-generation model to the White House and Congress to get launch clearance. It would be the first release under the administration's planned framework for submitting models to the government before public release. [Seoul Economic Daily](https://en.sedaily.com/international/2026/07/27/altman-to-demo-next-gen-ai-model-in-washington-after-self)
- Mid-July 2026: Hugging Face disclosed a breach caused by an autonomous agent, and OpenAI confirmed it was the source. The agent was described as "an even more capable pre-release model" than GPT-5.6 Sol and was running a cyber benchmark. 36Kr quoted Altman saying "We have suspended training," but I could not verify that quote. [Trending Topics](https://www.trendingtopics.eu/gpt-6-clues-are-piling-up-after-an-unreleased-openai-model-hacked-hugging-face/), [Astral Codex Ten](https://www.astralcodexten.com/p/the-hugging-face-incident), [36Kr](https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3906272984732804)
- 2026-07-09: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna reached general availability. The rollout had been staggered at the US government's request after a limited preview that began 2026-06-26. [Axios](https://axios.com/2026/07/09/ai-openai-gpt-release), [MacRumors](https://macrumors.com/2026/06/26/openai-gpt-5-6-sol/)

## 4. Base rates
- GPT-5 shipped in August 2025. Since then OpenAI has released 5.x versions roughly every 1 to 3 months: GPT-5.4, GPT-5.5 (an April 2026 model rumored to be "GPT-6" shipped under that name), then GPT-5.6 in June/July 2026. [Wikipedia GPT-5.5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5.5), [Wikipedia GPT-5.4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GPT-5.4)
- Rumored "GPT-6" models have been released under 5.x names before, so the naming risk is real.
- Recent frontier launches (GPT-5.6) went through a 2 to 3 week limited preview tied to government review before general availability. A limited or gated preview alone might count as a "closed beta" under this question's rules.
- Polymarket's market for GPT-6 by 2026-03-31 resolved No. [polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/573826)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Late July 2026: about 77-78% for a public release by 2026-09-30. At the same time, the 31 August contract was about 30-35% and the 21 August contract about 15%. [Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/374472/openai-gpt-6-will-arrive-september-prediction-market), [EdgeX](https://pro.edgex.exchange/en-US/news/article/prediction-markets-put-gpt-6-release-odds-near-78)
- Yahoo Finance reported Polymarket at 59% by 15 September and about 72% by 30 September. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/markets-confident-openai-releases-next-191526916.html)
- 2026-08-01: 62% by 30 September. 2026-08-13: 50% by 30 September. The trend through August is downward.
- Mid-August: the 15 September contract on a thinly traded mirror was about 21%. [Orrery](https://orrery.me/markets/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september-15-2026)
- The CryptoSlate odds page shows 31 October at 91% and 31 December at 93.5%, but the snapshot is undated, so I can't confirm it is from before 18 August. A 31 December snapshot at 84% is also undated. [CryptoSlate](https://cryptoslate.com/predictions/market/gpt-6-released-by/), [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/gpt-6-released-by-december-31-2026-polymarket-0x46c8159431)
- Manifold has a related market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/event/will-gpt-6-be-released-by-september)
- I could not find a reliable pre-18-August price for a contract ending exactly on 31 October.

## 6. Upcoming events before the deadline
- Whether the US government clears the next model, and how long any staged or limited preview lasts.
- OpenAI's naming decision: "GPT-6" versus "GPT-5.7".
- Whether the reported training pause and new safety work after the Hugging Face incident slow things down.
- Competitive pressure from Anthropic's expected Fable 5.1 launch.
- Polymarket's 15 September and 30 September contract deadlines, as checkpoints for how sentiment moves.

For No:

- Government pre-release review and staged rollouts could add weeks. A gated preview alone might not count as a public release.

**(e) Scenarios**
- No: Government review and post-incident safety work push general availability to November or later. Alternatively, OpenAI ships "Astra" in October as GPT-5.7.
- Yes: OpenAI gets clearance in September, runs a 2-3 week limited preview, and makes "GPT-6" generally available to Plus or Pro users in early to mid October.

**(f) From base rate to final probability**
- The market anchor is about 50% for release by 30 September, and that price already reflects naming risk.
- Adding another month, given the usual preview-to-general-availability lags, raises it to roughly 63-68%.
- I shade this down for the clear downward trend in August and the unpriced possibility that only a limited preview happens by 31 October.
- I give little weight to the undated 91% snapshot.

Net, I land somewhat below the extrapolated market figure.

Probability: 58%
